CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.meadow_littles_weekly(p_action text, p_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select meadow_littles_private.weekly(p_action,p_data)||meadow_littles_private.quality_status() $function$
